reuse.why: Uses getSheetValue, setBudget and the undoable mutator wrapper, but copies the category-selection query instead of extracting it for reuse across the month-wide actions.

duplication.why: The SQL selecting fillable categories (hidden, hidden group, saved-template exclusions) is pasted verbatim from set3MonthAvg, and the loop with the income/tracking check and sign flip mirrors the averages.

placement.why: Action sits in server/budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions and is registered in server/budget/app.ts like them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Straightforward to read, but it adds a fifth copy of the category-selection rule that must be kept in sync by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection helper exists in this tree; the existing handler-registration pattern is followed.

disguised_duplication.where: The category query in setLastMonthSpending is an open verbatim copy of set3MonthAvg's query.
